fusions.name: Spade Bash
fusions.desc: Brings the flat down and deals 15 damage, leaving the target 20% easier to wound for 6 seconds and stunned for 1 second.

fusions.name: Clod Barrage
fusions.desc: Throws 3 clods at once, each dealing 6 damage. Your movement speed rises 15% for 3 seconds. It holds 4 charges, and a kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Raised Berm
fusions.desc: Heaps a bank of earth 5 tiles long for 8 seconds. Nothing crosses it. An escort of chicks fights beside you for 10 seconds, striking for 4 every 1.4 seconds.

fusions.name: Hardpacked
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 12%. It also regenerates 0.3 health a second, permanently.
